headline: Granted variances for 6 Pearl Street garage, 19 Aiken Street sunroom, and 67 Frost Road garage; denied 32 Crystal Ave group recovery residence.
summary: The board granted three zoning variance requests for projects at 6 Pearl Street, 19 Aiken Street, and 67 Frost Road. It denied a request to operate a 10-bed men's group recovery residence at 32 Crystal Ave. It tabled a request for a child group daycare at 1.5 Hood Rd to 9/17/26.
decisions: Granted a variance for a commercial garage at 6 Pearl Street, 5-0.
Granted a variance for a sunroom at 19 Aiken Street, 5-0.
Granted a variance for a two-car garage with an ADU at 67 Frost Road, 5-0.
Denied a variance for a 10-bed men's group recovery residence at 32 Crystal Ave, 0-5.
Tabled the request for a child group daycare at 1.5 Hood Rd to 9/17/26.

decision_evidence.quote: Ms. Morin made a motion on case 26-118 to grant a variance to the terms of Article VI, Section 165-33B ... The application was GRANTED by a vote of 5-0.
Ms. Morin made a motion on case 26-125 to grant a variance to the terms of Article VI, Section 165-45.1.B.d ... The application was GRANTED by a vote of 5-0.
Ms. Morin made a motion on case 26-126 to grant a variance to the terms of Article III, Section 165-25.a ... The application was GRANTED by a vote of 5-0.
Ms. Morin made a motion on case 26-127 to grant a variance to the terms of Article VI, Section 165-32.1.A ... The application was DENIED by a vote of 0-5.
MOTION to table to 9/17/26 by Mr. Tripp, seconded by Mr. Donlan, all in favor
